newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes slightly down.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Tuesday closed slightly down by 0.20 percent in thin trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 596.92 from 598.11 on Monday.
Trade volume was 218,670 dinars against 326,228 dinars.
Banque du Sud was down 0.68 dinar to 23.52 dinars. BTEI bank was down 0.5 dinar to 22.5 dinars. ($=one dinar)
